verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Caveman publishes an OpenAPI spec at docs.caveman.so/openapi.json, and the docs describe connecting apps through a base-URL swap with per-key rate limits, so a documented programmatic API surface exists. Nothing shows what the API actually lets you control, such as starting agent chats, running automations, or managing budgets, so its scope may be limited to the proxy. Missing for 10: documented endpoints for driving core product actions (agents, automations, Cloud computers), API reference content beyond the spec's existence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
